nom: Live Tinted Hueguard 3-in-1 Mineral Sunscreen, Moisturizer, Primer SPF 30

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally describe the product as lightweight, mattifying enough to control shine, and not greasy, though one very oily reviewer found it drying and irritating with daily use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry/combination skin are split: several find it hydrating and a good base over moisturizer, while others report it dries their skin out or fails to be sufficiently moisturizing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it balances oil without excess shine, blurs texture, and layers well under makeup without pilling.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers frequently note it does not sting the eyes, does not flare rosacea, and is fragrance-free and gentle, though one reviewer who does not normally have sensitive skin reported burning eyes and peeling.
segments.normal: One reviewer with an expired-product complaint described the formula itself as suited to normal to slightly drier skin.

concerns.aging: Only incidental mention; one reviewer noted receiving compliments on how young her skin looked, but aging is not a concern reviewers discuss in depth.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the product as hydrating and a good layer over moisturizer for dry skin, but multiple others report it dries their skin out, sometimes even over a moisturizing serum or cream.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers with rosacea report the product does not flare their redness and is calming; no dissent is recorded on this point.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer felt the product pulled moisture through the barrier and left skin drier despite prepping with moisturizer.
concerns.spots: Reviewers who describe hyperpigmentation-prone or acne-prone skin say the tint helps camouflage discoloration and that the product did not worsen dark marks.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and one calls it a holy grail for acne-prone skin, but two others report it caused acne, including one describing cystic acne.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly describe it as refreshing, balancing, and non-greasy, though one very oily reviewer found it left a sticky, greasy after-feel that transferred to her phone.

aspects.libelle: White cast on deeper skin tones
No white cast on fair to light skin
Wears well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: The application is great. It applies well. Love that it was a three and one, but it did not absorb into my skin and left me greasy. It would transfer onto my phone. It also made me break out with cystic acne after starting this product. I don't have super sensitive skin. I wanted to love this, but I will not be buying it again.

extraits.titre: Almost Perfect! Not for Dry Skin
extraits.texte: This sunscreen is super lightweight, non-greasy, plays well under makeup, and has solid full spectrum protection….however it is not moisturizing for my dry/combo skin. In fact it drys me out even after applying it over a moisturizing serum and cream - it's like it sucks through the barrier and my skin is left feeling

extraits.titre: Not a Daily Sunscreen for Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I like this sunscreen but only if I plan to wear makeup during the day. I dont usually wear makeup daily, but when I'm on trips or going out during the day and want to look nice Ill wear a little bit of makeup (concealer, powder, bronzer, blush). This stuff works GREAT as a sunscreen + primer as my makeup sticks to it so well. It also does not leave any white cast, but make sure to rub in well as it dries fast on the skin and can sometimes leave streaks. I dont like to use it daily as it does not combine well with my topical acne medications (makes my face feel VERY sticky - which is nice when using makeup, but not nice without makeup). Also, I feel as thought it is pretty drying on my skin due to the mattifying effect and I'm a very oily gal. Using daily tends to slighty irritate my skin and cause dry patches. That being said, if youre a sweaty and oily faced person like me, this stuff is a holy grail to use under makeup - but if you also have sensitive skin, I dont recommend using daily.

This sunscreen/moisturizer/primer is fantastic in my opinion. My skin is very sensitive and responds best to mineral sunscreens. I also have a light skin tone but I am of eastern european and arab descent and my skin does have an olive undertoneand. A lot of mineral sunscreens will leave a slight white cast on me. This does not! I like that it feels very light and is not shiny or ultra matte after it dries down. I see that some people complain about an odd "smell" with this product and I do notice a slight smell BUT I don't notice it being overpowering and it seems to disappear after several seconds. I absolutely adore this stuff and it works perfectly for me. I will definitely buy this sunscreen again.

This stuff is gorgeous! I was initially a little intimidated by its orange color, but rest assured it sheers out completely and leaves no color on my super fair skin. The formula is so silky and hydrating. . it feels like a nice, lightweight moisturizer. Since I am on the drier side I apply this over my moisturizer and under my makeup as a primer and it wears beautifully! I also wear this on no makeup days and it works great that way too. I am very acne prone and this formula has caused no irritation and no new breakouts for me. This is a great choice for a daily spf and I could see this working for just about anyone!

It's my first trying Tinted and I'm already loving this brand. I have combo skin and finding right mineral spf has been difficult as they are either making me more oily or have white cast with ashy finish. This multitasker has non of the above mentioned issues. My skin feels hydrated, makeup looks great and doesn't pill, formula absorbs fast without making me oily. Definitely recommend it, this 3 in 1 product is amazing!

I have acne, prone skin, so it's hard for me to find a good sunscreen that sits nicely underneath my makeup and also looks good on its own without clogging my pores, or causing me to break out, but this one is perfect! Not only doesn't leave any type of weird cast. It melts into the skin so effortlessly, and looks great on its own and performs really well under makeup as well!
